extracted.name: KISS: Keep it Simple (Brussels) Sprouts
extracted.description: Sauteed brussels sprouts are seasoned with nothing more than salt and pepper and cooked only briefly.
ingredient_lines: 1 pound Brussels sprouts, trimmed and halved lengthwise
instruction_lines: Put Brussels sprouts in a large bowl. Drizzle olive oil over the sprouts; season with salt and pepper. Toss sprouts to coat.
Heat a large skillet over medium heat; cook and stir sprouts in hot skillet until bright green and beginning to brown on edges, about 5 minutes.
